Package com.egradx.audit.web

Record Class EgradxAuditFilter

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.egradx.audit.web.EgradxAuditFilter
Record Components:
from - inclusive, ISO-8601 (2026-09-30T00:00:00Z)
to - exclusive
q - a fragment of an entity's or actor's label, an entity id, or an action
organizationId - platform endpoint only: one organization's records
platformOnly - platform endpoint only: records that belong to no organization
public record EgradxAuditFilter(Instant from, Instant to, List<String> action, String actionPrefix, List<String> category, List<EgradxAuditOutcome> outcome, List<UUID> actorId, List<EgradxAuditActor.Type> actorType, String entityType, String entityId, String correlationId, String changedField, String q, UUID organizationId, Boolean platformOnly) extends Record
The filters of GET /events and its export, as query parameters. Repeat a parameter to allow several values (?outcome=FAILURE&outcome=DENIED); different parameters combine.
